messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: p99_latency_eu-west > 1200ms (threshold breached). Incident INC12345 created. https://pagerduty.example/INC12345
pagerduty: Incident INC12345 assigned to oncall (alex). Priority: P1
alex: ack
alex: taking this — will triage autoscaler, sidecars, and model rollout
mike: seeing sidecar queue depth spike on eu-west-b-02, tail tokens/request up ~3x
sara: checking dashboards — p99 spike lines up with canary rollout ~12:10 (model-redwood-v2-quantized-canary)
alex: rollback option on the table, any errors reported to customers?
sara: no customer errors, just high latency tails for some sessions (non-critical customers). internal impact ~5% requests hitting p99
jen: infra look: GPU util normal, but model cache I/O latency spiked around the same time
ops-bot: runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/latency-p99 — recommends fallback to stable model variant and scale sidecar pool
alex: initiating immediate fallback to model-redwood-v1-stable for eu-west canary group
mike: also applying batch cap change to reduce max batch size: BATCH_MAX=5 for canary pods
jen: confirming autoscaler didn't get stuck in cooldown, bumped min replicas by +2 for eu-west canary pool
alex: applied rollback at 1761123605 — warming pods to avoid cold starts
incident-bot: ack recorded by alex at 1761123590
alex: monitoring p99 after rollback — will update in thread
mike: quick logs snippet:
```
2026-03-17T12:14:05Z lv=warn kvcache.io=high key=canary/model load=0.84s
2026-03-17T12:14:06Z p99=1350ms p95=210ms rps=240
```
sara: good signal — p99 trending down, cleared alert at 1761123698 (within ~90s after rollback)
alex: holding for 5m to confirm stability, do not resume canary until post-checks done
jen: created post-incident task: TASK-INC12345-1 assign: mike, sara — investigate cache eviction & rollout gating
ops-bot: note: customer-impact flag = partial-latency-degrade, notify support if more than 10% affected in 15m
alex: thanks all — will update once stable, if escalation required we'll trigger PD escalation path
mike: quick note — add KV cache metrics to canary health check (proposal)
sara: agreed, adding to postmortem notes
alex: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC12345 resolved at 1761123720
